description: This file defines a PHP class `CustomerTransaction` in the Opencart admin extension, responsible for handling customer transaction reports, including display, search, save configurations, and generating report views.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer transaction reports, including rendering forms, saving settings, and displaying report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the customer transaction report form page with breadcrumbs and configuration options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report settings, with permission check, and returns success or error message in JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer transaction report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list output, typically used for AJAX or partial updates.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches, paginates, and renders the customer transaction report data based on filters.
